sentences.en: Good morning everyone, and welcome to the Museum of Farming Life.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好，欢迎来到农业生活博物馆。

sentences.en: I understand it's your first visit here, so I'd like to give you some background information about the museum and then explain a little about what you can see during your visit.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是你们第一次来这里参观，因此我想先向大家简要介绍一下博物馆的背景，然后再说明一下参观期间可以看到的内容。

sentences.en: So, where we're standing at the moment is the entrance to a large building that was constructed in 1880 as the home of a local businessman, Alfred Palmer, of the Palmer biscuit factory. t was later sold and became : hall of residence for students in 1911, and a museum in 1951.
sentences.zh: 此刻我们所站的位置，是这座大型建筑的入口。该建筑建于1880年，最初是当地商人、帕尔默饼干厂老板阿尔弗雷德·帕尔默的住宅。后来该建筑被出售，于1911年成为学生宿舍，又于1951年改为博物馆。

sentences.en: In 2005, a modern extension was built to accommodate the museum's collections.
sentences.zh: 2005年，为容纳博物馆藏品，增建了一座现代化的附属建筑。

sentences.en: The museum's owned by the university, and apart from two rooms that are our offices, the university uses the main part of the building.
sentences.zh: 博物馆由大学所有；除两间用作我们办公室的房间外，大学使用该建筑的主体部分。

sentences.en: You may see students going into the building.
sentences.zh: 你们可能会看到学生进入这栋建筑。

sentences.en: for lessons, but it's not open to museum visitors, I'm afraid.
sentences.zh: 他们去上课，但抱歉，这部分不对博物馆游客开放。

sentences.en: It's a shame because the interior architectural features are outstanding, especially the room that used to be the library.
sentences.zh: 这很遗憾，因为其内部建筑特色极为出众，尤其是原先用作图书馆的那个房间。

sentences.en: Luckily, we've managed to keep entry to the museum free.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我们成功地将博物馆入场维持在免费状态。

sentences.en: This includes access to all the galleries, outdoor areas and the rooms for special exhibitions.
sentences.zh: 这包括所有展厅、户外区域以及特展专用房间的全部访问权限。

sentences.en: We run activities for children and students, such as the museum club, for which there's no charge.
sentences.zh: 我们为儿童和学生举办各类活动，例如‘博物馆俱乐部’，完全免费。

sentences.en: We do have a donation box just over there so feel free to give whatever amount you consider appropriate.
sentences.zh: 那边设有一个捐赠箱，欢迎大家根据自己的意愿自愿捐款。

sentences.en: We do have a cloakroom, if you'd like to leave your coats and bags somewhere.
sentences.zh: 我们设有衣帽间，如需寄存外套和背包，可随时使用。

sentences.en: Unlike other museums, photography is allowed here, so you might like to keep your cameras with you.
sentences.zh: 与其他博物馆不同，本馆允许拍照，因此建议您随身携带相机。

sentences.en: You might be more comfortable not carrying around heavy rucksacks, though keep your coats and jackets on as it's quite cold in the museum garden today.
sentences.zh: 不过，背着沉重的背包可能不太舒适；但请仍穿着外套和夹克，因为今天博物馆花园内相当寒冷。

sentences.en: I'd like to tell you about the different areas of the museum.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我为大家介绍一下博物馆的不同展区。

sentences.en: Just inside, and outside the main gallery, we have an area called Four Seasons.
sentences.zh: 一进门、主展厅外侧，有一处名为‘四季’的区域。

sentences.en: Here you can watch a four-minute animation of a woodland scene.
sentences.zh: 在这里，您可以观看一段四分钟的林地场景动画短片。

sentences.en: It was designed especially for the museum by a group of young people on a film studies course, and it's beautiful.
sentences.zh: 该短片由一群修读电影研究课程的年轻人专为本馆设计，画面非常精美。

sentences.en: Children absolutely love it, but then, so do adults.
sentences.zh: 孩子们尤其喜爱它，其实成年人也同样喜欢。

sentences.en: The main gallery's called Town and Country.
sentences.zh: 主展厅名为‘城镇与乡村’。

sentences.en: It includes a photographic collection of prize- winning sheep and shepherds.
sentences.zh: 其中包含一组获奖绵羊及牧羊人的摄影收藏。

sentences.en: Leaving Town and Country, you enter Farmhouse Kitchen, which is ... well, self-explanatory.
sentences.zh: 离开‘城镇与乡村’展厅后，您将进入‘农舍厨房’——顾名思义，即一处复原的农家厨房。

sentences.en: Here we have the oldest collection of equipment for making Audioscripts butter and cheese in the country.
sentences.zh: 这里陈列着全国历史最悠久的一批制作黄油和奶酪的设备。

sentences.en: And this morning, a specialist cheesemaker will be giving demonstrations of how it's produced.
sentences.zh: 今天上午，一位专业奶酪制作师将现场演示这些设备的使用方法及奶酪的制作过程。

sentences.en: You may even get to try some.
sentences.zh: 您甚至有机会品尝一些。

sentences.en: After that, you can go in two directions.
sentences.zh: 之后，您可选择两个方向继续参观。

sentences.en: To the right is a staircase that takes you up to a landing from where you can look down on the galleries.
sentences.zh: 向右是一段楼梯，通往一个平台，从那里可以俯瞰各展厅。

sentences.en: To a the left is a room called A Year on the Farm.
sentences.zh: 向左则是一间名为‘农场一年’的房间。

sentences.en: There's lots of seating here as sometimes we use the room for school visits, so it's a good place to stop for a rest.
sentences.zh: 这里设有大量座椅，因我们有时会用此房间接待学校团体，所以也是休息的好地方。

sentences.en: If you're feeling competitive. you can take our memory test in which you answer questions about things you've seen in the museum.
sentences.zh: 若您喜欢挑战，还可参加我们的记忆测试，在其中回答有关您在博物馆所见内容的问题。

sentences.en: The next area's called Wagon Walk.
sentences.zh: 下一个展区名为‘马车步道’。

sentences.en: This contains farm carts from nearly every part of the country.
sentences.zh: 这里陈列着来自全国几乎每个地区的农用马车。

sentences.en: It's surprising how much regional variation there was.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，各地马车之间存在显著的地域差异。

sentences.en: Beside the carts are display boards with information about each one.
sentences.zh: 每辆马车旁均配有信息展板，介绍其相关背景。

sentences.en: The carts are old and fragile, so we ask you to keep.
sentences.zh: 这些马车年代久远且十分脆弱，因此我们恳请您务必看管好您的孩子，

sentences.en: your children close to you and ensure they don't climb on the carts.
sentences.zh: 并确保他们不要攀爬马车。

sentences.en: From Wagon Walk, you can either make your way back to reception or go out into the garden - or even go back to take another look in the galleries.
sentences.zh: 从‘马车步道’出发，您可返回接待处，也可前往花园，甚至可折返再次参观展厅。

sentences.en: In the far corner of the garden is Bees are Magic, but we're redeveloping this area so you can't visit that at the moment.
sentences.zh: 花园最远角落原为‘蜜蜂的魔力’展区，但目前该区域正在重新开发，暂时无法参观。

sentences.en: You can still buy our honey in the shop, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，您仍可在商店购买我们的蜂蜜。

sentences.en: Finally, there's The Pond, which contains all kinds of interesting wildlife.
sentences.zh: 最后是池塘，里面栖息着各种有趣的野生动物。

sentences.en: There are baby ducks that are only a few days old, as well as tiny frogs.
sentences.zh: 这里有只有几天大的小鸭子，还有小小的青蛙。

sentences.en: The Pond isn't deep and there's a fence around it, sO it's perfectly safe for children.
sentences.zh: 池塘并不深，周围还设有围栏，因此对儿童来说非常安全。
